app.name: CleanSpot
app.tagline: Report illegal waste dumps and clear them together.

landing.title: Less litter in our countryside
landing.intro: With CleanSpot you report illegal waste dumps in under a minute – with a photo and location. Volunteers and the municipality take care of the rest.
